data.narrative:
Atopile is a Seed-stage company operating in Robotics & Manufacturing, founded by Matthew Wildoer, Narayan Powderly, and Timothée Peter. The target has raised $500K to date. The relevant comp universe comprises nine private robotics and manufacturing companies (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics) and one public comparable.

Stage-progression valuation is applicable and represents the sole quantifiable method. Using total raised ($500K) as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $1.25M. Peer-median methodology cannot be reliably applied; while ten same-sector peers exist, insufficient narrow-filter matches (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier) preclude a statistically defensible median. The broader sector median would introduce unwarranted noise given stage and capital-raise heterogeneity across the robotics landscape.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.06M to $1.44M (median $1.25M), anchored exclusively to stage-progression. Key uncertainties include the company's actual burn trajectory, product-market progress since the $500K raise, and relative competitive positioning within a fragmented robotics sector. The single-method reliance reflects genuine data scarcity at the Seed stage rather than analytical confidence. Any forward valuation must be stress-tested against near-term product and revenue milestones.
